title: It’s easy to feel buried by confusion, anxiety, and the storms of life.
paragraphs: It’s easy to feel buried by confusion, anxiety, and the storms of life. But look at this truth: We serve a God who specializes in the impossible. If He can command water to flow in the driest desert, He can absolutely break through your mental chaos with His divine clarity.
The storm you are in is not your destination; it’s just the battlefield where your breakthrough is being forged. Hold your ground. The light is breaking through.
⚔️ Scripture anchor: "See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland." - Isaiah 43:19 (NIV)
